Homogeneity and completeness are also low (0.10 and 0.07 for stage; 0.08 and 0.05 for grade). These metrics suggest that the partition is not simply a recapitulation of stage or grade. The VHL enrichment has an extremely wide confidence interval due to small counts, and no other modality provides coherent support. Cross-modal consistency is weak with near-zero silhouettes and low patient support. Measured technical factors do not provide a dominant alternative explanation, but the absence of positive identity evidence beyond a single common mutation makes the set insufficiently defensible for retention. Drop is better supported than accept because there is no affirmative evidence for a distinct subtype, and no structural correction or extra evidence is available to resolve this.

C0002 has a coherent molecular identity defined by significant enrichment of PIK3CA, PTEN, and SETD2 mutations, with large effect sizes and consistent direction, suggesting a PI3K/PTEN pathway-altered phenotype. Although RNA and CNV are not significant, the mutation pattern is biologically plausible and not merely an isolated observation. Cross-modal consistency is weak but not actively contradictory, and the set-specific technical association with a scanner model is unlikely to explain the mutation enrichment. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge, and no extra evidence is available. Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is better supported than dropping it.

The lack of a coherent biological program beyond a single common mutation, combined with the absence of significant CNV or relevant RNA signal, makes the set insufficiently defensible. No structural correction or extra evidence is available, so drop is better supported than accept.

Although CNV is null and cross-modal consistency is moderate, the RNA and mutation evidence are coherent and not dominated by technical factors. No positive structural evidence supports split or merge, and no extra evidence is available. Retaining C0004 for downstream validation is better supported than dropping it.
